title: Man Hits Police Officers with Car Before Fleeing Traffic Stop
description:
On January 22, 2022, police were notified of a subject passed out in a running vehicle in Oak Creek, WI. Upon approach, they observed the driver hunched over and noticed an open bottle of liquor in the car. After finally waking up, the man subsequently fled after striking two officers with the door of the vehicle.
